subject: Invitation to Annual Company Gala Dinner
body: Dear Team, We are thrilled to invite you to our annual company gala dinner on Saturday, December 18th at the Grand Ballroom. Join us for an evening filled with delicious food, live music, and exciting awards ceremony. Don't miss this opportunity to celebrate our achievements and mingle with your colleagues. Please RSVP by December 10th. We look forward to seeing you there! Best regards, The Event Planning Committee
